title: Open Jam @ Herb's Hideout
event_description: Weekly all-genre open jam welcoming musicians to bring their instruments and play. Backline provided including drums bass and guitar. Free event with a supportive atmosphere.
backline: Yes - drums bass guitar and PA system
event_venue_information:
About Herb's Hideout

Herb's Hideout stands as one of Denver's most authentic music venues - a historic tavern erected in 1933 that has worn many hats throughout its long tenure. Located in the heart of LoDo this dive bar maintains its unpretentious character while hosting live music six nights a week.

The Venue Vibe

Herb's has managed to remain a go-to respite from gentrified surroundings offering reasonably priced stiff drinks and an authentic dive bar atmosphere. The venue features a small intimate stage perfect for close-up musical experiences. Winner of Best Bar in LoDo to Pretend You're on Colfax (2025) and Best Unpretentious Yet Legendary Venue (2023).

Music Programming

The venue hosts live music Monday through Saturday with regular performers on Mondays Tuesdays and Thursdays. Wednesday's open jam is particularly popular drawing musicians of all skill levels. Fridays and Saturdays feature Pop/Rock/Top 40 bands. The space is known for its jazz Tuesday nights which draw enthusiastic crowds.

What Musicians Get

Complete backline including drums bass guitar and PA system. A supportive audience that actually came for the music. Reasonable drink prices. An authentic Denver music venue with decades of history. The venue operates 3 PM to 2 AM Friday-Sunday and 6 PM to 2 AM Monday-Thursday.

title: Monday Night Jam @ Swallow Hill Music
event_description: Multi-genre jam session led by Spencer Erik Crawford covering everything from Zydeco to Prince to bluegrass classics. Spencer calls out chords and changes while encouraging participants to lead tunes. Donation-based with suggested $10 minimum.
event_venue_information:
About Swallow Hill Music

Swallow Hill Music is a nonprofit community music school with a tradition of open jam sessions dating back to the 1960s when it was part of the Denver Folklore Center. The venue operates as Denver's premier destination for acoustic music education and community gathering.

Facilities

Weekly jams are held in the Quinlan Cafe downstairs with monthly genre-specific jams held in various rooms throughout the building. The venue provides a welcoming accessible space with quality acoustics for collaborative music-making.

Jam Session Programming

Swallow Hill offers an extensive weekly and monthly jam schedule including Monday Night Jam (multi-genre) Tuesday Night Jam (bluegrass and cowboy classics) Bluegrass Jam (4th Sundays) Jazz Jam (2nd Sundays) Irish Jam (1st Sundays) Old-Time Jam (3rd Sundays) Circle Singing (3rd Saturdays) Denver Uke Community (3rd Saturdays) Clawhammer Corner (last Thursdays online) and Tabla Jam (4th Saturdays). All jams are led by expert instructors and community members.

What Musicians Get

Access to Denver's longest-running jam session tradition. Expert instruction and facilitation. A supportive all-levels-welcome environment. Connection to Denver's acoustic music community. Suggested $10 donation supports teachers and the music school. The venue is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit with tax ID 84-0781725.

title: Wednesday Open Mic @ Lion's Lair
event_description: Denver's hottest open stage featuring a showcase set from local or touring bands at 8pm followed by open mic starting at 9pm. Backline provided. Free to attend with midnight happy hour from midnight to 1:30am.
backline: Yes - drums guitar bass and PA system
event_venue_information:
About Lion's Lair

Lion's Lair is an iconic dive bar established in 1969 on Denver's famous Colfax Avenue. This legendary venue has hosted thousands of acts over the decades including Jonathan Richman Detroit Cobras White Stripes Black Keys Decemberists and many more. Winner of Best Open-Mic Night in Denver (2025 Readers' Choice).

The Venue

A cozy authentic dive bar known for its unpretentious atmosphere affordable drinks and vibrant live music scene. The intimate small stage creates close connections between performers and audience. The venue maintains the classic dive feel that has made it a Denver institution for over 50 years.

Weekly Programming

Live music Thursday through Sunday nights. Monday nights feature Open Mic Comedy Night (sign up 10pm start 10:30pm). Second Tuesdays host live music with Coverboy. Wednesday nights are the music open mic (8pm showcase 9pm open stage). Saturday afternoons 2-6pm feature Kooky Kitsch with DJ Frank Bell. Sunday nights offer karaoke.

What Musicians Get

Full backline including drums guitar bass and sound system. A judgment-free zone to rock your songs. Midnight happy hour for performers and attendees. Connection to Denver's legendary underground music scene. Affordable drinks and authentic dive bar atmosphere. The venue opens at 6pm Monday-Wednesday and 3pm Thursday-Sunday running until 2am nightly.
